documents.body: Hire Me — The Markk Brandon Collective Loading… MBC v1.5.5 The Markk Brandon Collective Front Page About The Classifieds Security Downloads Support Hire Me Section H Hire Me Build requests Request a build Tell me what you need · add your min–max · I'll reach out Front Page / Hire Me This page stays open for people who want me to build their website or app. I've gained a ton of knowledge developing these projects over the past two to three years — right after about five years building game servers (Minecraft, FiveM, Assetto Corsa, Beaming, and yes, sadly, a Roblox server). That path taught me how to ship things people actually use, not just screenshots. I feel ready to put myself out there and start building for others — at a cost, of course. Here's where you make that request: say what you want, add your price range (min–max), and I'll reach out if it's something I can take on. No fake “instant quote” bots. Just me reading what you sent. What you get when we work together is the same standard I hold my own apps to — full stack when that's what you need, real databases, tested flows, buttons that work. AI helps me move faster; the experience is what makes it finish. And I don't call…

THE MARKK BRANDON COLLECTIVE

> Apps & websites by **Markk Brandon** · **Markeith Nicholas White** — free ones to try, a GoFundMe to keep them running, and a door to hire me.

**Version:** **v1.5.13** (see [`version.json`](version.json))

Live site

**Canonical host:** [themarkkbradoncollective.github.io/main](https://themarkkbradoncollective.github.io/main/)

**Repository:** [github.com/TheMarkkBradonCollective/main](https://github.com/TheMarkkBradonCollective/main)

This newspaper site ships on **GitHub Pages** only. The old repo name (`TheMarkkade.io`) and Vercel project (`the-markkade-io` / `themarkkbrandoncollective.vercel.app`) are retired — ignore those URLs if they still 404.

> After deleting the Vercel project, also clear the GitHub repo **Homepage** URL if it still points at `*.vercel.app` (Settings → General → Website). Point it at the Pages link above.
